title: Juicy Argentine Khus Khus Empanadas
description: A resinous, crumbly empanada with aromatic khus khus spice and lean beef, baked in an air fryer for a diabetic-friendly twist.

ingredients.name: khus khus powder
ingredients.notes: blend of cumin, coriander, chili, smoked paprika

instructions: Mix chickpea flour, salt, and water until a smooth dough forms.
Roll the dough into thin circles and cut into 8 equal portions.
Sauté onion, garlic, bell pepper, and ground beef in olive oil until cooked, then stir in tomato paste, khus khus powder, and cilantro.
Divide the filling into the dough circles and fold over, sealing edges with a fork.
Brush each empanada with beaten egg to promote browning.
Place the empanadas in a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Cook for 12 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and crisp.
Let the empanadas cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve warm with a side of fresh salsa or a light arugula salad.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
